CCNY Secret Planetarium on Instagram: "Apollo 8 and Artemis II

Here we see the path Apollo 8 took to the moon on the bottom pane, compared with the planned trajectory for Artemis II, set to launch this Wednesday, April 1st. 

Apollo 8 was the first crewed mission (to the moon) during the Apollo era of space flight. It orbited the moon 10 times and returned to Earth after a 6 day mission. Artemis II will not spend time orbiting the moon, but will use the lunar gravity to redirect its course and send it back to Earth after a quick flyby. Similarly, this will be the first crewed mission to then moon in the modern era of space exploration. 

Simulated and Rendered with OpenSpace, the free Astro-visualization software. @openspaceproj
Trajectory data from JPL Horizons

*note: the data provided by NASA JPL that was used to create this visualization only starts 3 hours into the flight, so the first Low Earth Orbit is not shown, just the second high orbit before TLI.

Not for redistribution without written permission.
See: https://ccnyplanetarium.org/media-faq/ for more."
